what: First execution of the SHCT->OpenFOAM coupling against a real OpenFOAM install.
why: Every previous test of this path wrote interFoam cases and asserted on the files; none had ever been executed. Running them is what exposed the findings below.

environment.case: case study, as-operated scenario, 70 cells, 12 realisations

setFields.note: 0.356 is the cell-centre discretisation of 0.3637; the liquid_level mapping is consistent

case_validity.interFoam: runs to completion on the unmodified auto-generated case

circularity_of_the_holdup_comparison.method: same section (x=23.1 km), same mesh, same 2 s, only the imposed liquid fraction changed
circularity_of_the_holdup_comparison.conclusion: with inlet_mode=holdup the CFD returns whatever it is given, to within its own +-0.3% oscillation, over a three-fold range. The manifest's rel_diff_pct is a consistency check on the case writer, not a validation of the holdup closure; couple_iterate driven by a real run converges at iteration 0 having changed nothing.

defects_found_by_running_it.what: Allrun reported success when every stage had failed
defects_found_by_running_it.evidence: empty PATH: blockMesh/setFields/interFoam all fail, script prints 'done', exit 0
defects_found_by_running_it.consequence: run_case(check=True) recorded "ran": true for a case where nothing ran

defects_found_by_running_it.what: Allrun aborted before blockMesh when WM_PROJECT_DIR was unset
defects_found_by_running_it.evidence: `. ${WM_PROJECT_DIR:?}/...` is a fatal expansion error for the `.` builtin; exit 2
defects_found_by_running_it.consequence: the condition openfoam_available() reports as available could not run

defects_found_by_running_it.what: ingest_results returned the last instantaneous sample
defects_found_by_running_it.evidence: section 1 holdup passes through 0.3598, 0.3657, 0.3639 at 0.1/1.2/1.6 s
defects_found_by_running_it.consequence: abs_diff carried the phase of the oscillation rather than the closure

defects_found_by_running_it.what: ingest_results sorted restart time directories lexicographically
defects_found_by_running_it.consequence: vals[-1] was not the latest time

defects_found_by_running_it.what: identify_critical_sections took max(j, 0.05), destroying the sign
defects_found_by_running_it.evidence: at the riser base 92% of realisations sit exactly on the solver's -2.0 m/s momentum clip; the case was written with an inlet of +0.05 m/s
defects_found_by_running_it.consequence: direction reversed and magnitude 40x too small for the highest-scoring section. Correcting it moved that section's SHCT-vs-CFD difference from 16.9% to 2.0%

defects_found_by_running_it.what: writeInterval was fixed at 0.1 s regardless of endTime
defects_found_by_running_it.evidence: end_time=0.02 produced no write time at all
defects_found_by_running_it.consequence: the case ran, Allrun exited 0, ingest_results found 'result file empty'

defects_found_by_running_it.what: seg_len_factor was unreachable from couple() and the CLI
defects_found_by_running_it.consequence: every case ever generated was 12 diameters long

flagged_not_changed.what: the two phases are not distinct at the selected sections
flagged_not_changed.evidence: EOS flash gives vapour fraction V = 0.0000 at 115.2/106.2/95.2 bar and 9.5/8.0/7.4 C, so the PVT table's gas column returns the liquid root: rho_g = 560/560/499 against rho_l = 975, density ratios 1.7-2.0
flagged_not_changed.why_not_changed: which density is right is a question about the fluid model

flagged_not_changed.what: the riser-base mixture velocity is pinned on the solver's momentum clip
flagged_not_changed.evidence: 92% of realisations at x = 30.4 km sit exactly on UM_CLIP_LO = -2.0 m/s
flagged_not_changed.why_not_changed: retuning a momentum clip moves published case-study numbers

flagged_not_changed.what: cases are solved laminar at Re ~ 1.5e5
flagged_not_changed.why_not_changed: adding a turbulence model changes the case and its cost

pvt_gas_column.was: flash returns y = z when the mixture does not split, so eos_properties reported the FEED at its vapour root as the gas. 23 of the 49 default PVT nodes had no vapour; all returned 490-595 kg/m3 against a liquid of 975. Across one grid interval at 100 bar the gas density stepped 100.8 -> 556.1 and gas_sg 0.65 -> 1.76.
pvt_gas_column.now: build_pvt_table fills the gas columns at single-phase nodes from the composition of the vapour the fluid actually releases on that isotherm, compressed to the node's own P and T. The surface is continuous across the phase boundary (100 bar: 108.0/104.9/100.8 at 4/10/20 C) and 272 kg/m3 at 300 bar.
pvt_gas_column.effect: section density ratio 1.7-2.0 -> ~8; phases_distinct now True

momentum_clip.was: UM_CLIP_LO = -2.0; 92% of riser-base realisations sat exactly on it
momentum_clip.now: UM_CLIP_LO = -10.0. -10 and -20 give bit-identical fields, so the bound was inside the answer rather than holding back a divergence; fallbacks stayed 0 and the mass error at machine precision throughout.

turbulence.was: simulationType laminar at a mixture Reynolds number of 1e5-2.6e5
turbulence.now: k-omega SST above RE_TURBULENT = 4000, with 0/k, 0/omega, 0/nut from the standard pipe estimates (I = 0.16 Re^-1/8, l = 0.07 D), a wallDist meshWave entry and a '(k|omega).*' solver block. Both of the latter were found by running it: interFoam aborts on a missing wallDist method after selecting the model, and on 'omegaFinal' not found after taking a time step.
turbulence.effect: CFD slip at 12 D: +0.0009 laminar -> +0.0017 k-omega SST, against SHCT +0.110

inlet_mode_default.was: holdup, which imposes the quantity the comparison exists to check

rerun_file_shadowing.was: OpenFOAM keeps an existing volFieldValue.dat and writes a re-run to volFieldValue_0.dat, so ingest_results read the stale run -- or reported 'result file empty' for a case that had run to End
rerun_file_shadowing.now: every volFieldValue*.dat in each time directory is read, oldest file first

parallel.now: write_case emits system/decomposeParDict and, for n_procs > 1, an Allrun that runs decomposePar -> mpirun interFoam -parallel -> reconstructPar; exposed as --openfoam-procs

periodic_domain.now: write_case(domain='periodic') emits the cyclic case -- cyclic end patches, meanVelocityForce, and the pRefCell a fully closed domain needs -- and measure_distribution_parameter reads C0, u_gas and u_liquid off the field.

drift_flux_closure_measured.question: does the 3-D CFD reproduce the slip the 1-D drift-flux closure predicts, and specifically its distribution parameter C0?
drift_flux_closure_measured.how_C0_is_measured: directly off the field as the profile covariance C0 = <alpha_g u>/(<alpha_g><u>), volume-weighted, rather than inferred from the volume-averaged holdup
drift_flux_closure_measured.not_separable: C0 and the drift velocity v_d are NOT separately observable from a field: with C0 defined as above, u_g - C0*j vanishes identically, so the split is a modelling convention. The comparison is made on the effective C0 = u_g/j, which is what the two combine to form.

closure_value.note: solver.drift_params at this section's inclination and diameter

developing_segment_measures_the_entrance.case: L/D = 50, k-omega SST, noslip inlet, 8 s
developing_segment_measures_the_entrance.conclusion: monotone and still climbing at the outlet with no plateau. Every developing-segment number reported earlier -- laminar and turbulent, 12 D and 50 D -- was measuring how far the entrance region had got, not the closure.

periodic_domain_settles_it.case: L/D = 12 with cyclic end patches driven by meanVelocityForce at the section's mixture flux, k-omega SST, initialised at the closure's holdup. No entrance region exists, so the profiles are the developed ones.
periodic_domain_settles_it.conclusion: THE DRIFT-FLUX CLOSURE IS CONFIRMED TO 2.3 %. C0 changes by 0.5 % over the last 27 of 34 passes and the holdup is conserved exactly, so the run is settled. The closure runs slightly high, which is the expected sign for a correlation fitted across inclinations and applied to a near-horizontal section.

drift_flux_closure_measured.what_this_supersedes: earlier entries in this record reported the CFD showing essentially no slip and concluded the coupling could not reach the closure. That conclusion was an artefact of measuring a developing segment; it is withdrawn.
